text:
Anna L: Heads up — we're seeing sustained queuing on eu-west GPUs for the last 12m. p95 generation latency crossed SLO (600ms) and samples show lots of max-batch stalls.
Anna L: alert from infra-bot: `gpu_queue_depth > 80% for 10m` for cluster eu-west-2, pods with pack_window spikes.
infra-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-2: gpu_queue_depth=86% avg_max_batch_wait=220ms prefix_cache_hit=12%
Jamal: Hmm, looks like continuous prefill + small-chat traffic causing KV cache growth and packer holding packets to hit max_batch. head-of-line blocking.
Maria P: Can we confirm whether this is a single noisy tenant or global traffic? I see correlation with a run of low-latency demo traffic from CID 0x9f.
Kai: Running a quick query on Prometheus: `sum(rate(requests_total{region="eu-west"}[5m])) by (customer)` — gives a small set of customers driving 65% of requests.
Anna L: Logs from a single busy GPU node: `pack_window_ms=16 max_batch=64 effective_batch=64 wait_ms=180 admitted=64` repeated. Also `kv_cache_miss_ratio=0.88` so prefill is ineffective.
Jamal: That explains cost/latency: system keeps filling to 64 to optimize throughput, but we hit max-batch frequently and latency spikes while waiting for last few tokens.
Maria P: Options: 1) reduce max_batch for eu-west pool to 48 (faster tail), 2) lower pack_window to 8ms to prefer latency, 3) apply per-customer rate limit for noisy CID. Tradeoffs: throughput loss vs latency SLO recover.
Kai: Autoscaler isn't helping because scale-up cooldown is 5m and provisioning GPUs takes 9-12m. We need short-term mitigations.
Anna L: Can we try (2) pack_window=8ms on a canary subset of nodes and (3) throttle CID 0x9f by 30%?
Jamal: +1 for canary. Also propose enabling prefix cache prefill for busiest models — prefill jobs currently disabled in eu-west due to earlier instability. Might reduce KV miss ratio.
Maria P: I'll open an ops ticket for enabling prefill and track regression. For immediate: Kai, can you push pack_window change to 2 nodes and apply rate-limit to CID?
Kai: On it. Will push a deployment to node-group eu-west-fast-canary: set PACK_WINDOW_MS=8 MAX_BATCH=48 and create a temporary internal quota `rate_limit:customer:0x9f:0.7`.
Kai: Command I'm running: ```
# patch daemonset for canary
kubectl -n redwood patch daemonset packer-daemon --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/1/value","value":"8"}]'
```
Anna L: Nice. After patch: watch `gpu_queue_depth`, `p95_gen_latency`, and `effective_batch` — also watch `billing/throughput_tps` for cost hit.
infra-bot: [INFO] rollout started for packer-daemon (eu-west-fast-canary). progress=10%
sre-oncall: Noted. I'll keep incident console open and pause bulk CI demos for eu-west to reduce noise. @Customer Success please ping the demo team.
Maria P: Also propose short-term admission policy tweak: prefer unpacked small requests (priority) when max_batch is full — reduces head-of-line for interactive users. Implementation risk moderate.
Jamal: That so-called "small-first" admission will help latency but may reduce GPU utilization. For now, small-first + pack_window decrease on canary; if that recovers SLO we can expand.
Kai: Canary rolled to 2 nodes. infra-bot shows queue_depth on canary nodes down to 52% after 4m, p95 dropped from 720ms -> 380ms on canary.
Anna L: Good sign. We'll wait 10m and then decide to expand to 20% of eu-west pool. Keep rate-limit on CID until prefill jobs are re-enabled.
Maria P: Filing follow-up tasks: TKT-1247 enable-prefill-eu-west, TKT-1248 small-first-admission. Adding cost analysis: if we lower max_batch globally we'll increase token cost ~6-9% for eu-west steady load.
Jamal: Add note: long-term fix could be smarter dynamic max-batch based on incoming latency budget per request + adaptive prefill. Placeholder research item for eng-ml.
Anna L: Thanks all. If canary stabilizes we expand and close incident. Recording final decision: rollback path is apply previous daemonset env and remove rate limit.
infra-bot: [RESOLVE] alert auto-clear candidate after 18m of improved metrics on canary.
Kai: Marking action done in the incident board. Will follow-up in ops ticket with exact kube commands and metrics snapshots. :white_check_mark:
Maria P: Great. Postmortem if we fail to hit SLO after expansion. Otherwise we'll convert the canary config into a proper autoscale knob.
Anna L: Closing thread for now — monitoring open. Thanks team. :coffee:
